name: merit

scripts.//typecheck: `pnpm -r` walks the WORKSPACE, and scripts/demo is deliberately not a package in it. So the demo's project is named here: a TypeScript directory no `tsc` invocation reaches is a directory that rots, and the alternative (making a demo a workspace package) spends a VG-12 admission on a script that prints a table.
scripts.//falsify:ci: The CI-01, CI-02 and CI-05 gates watched failing on a seeded violation. NOT part of `verify`, and the reason is the one repo-invariants.mjs states: a check that cannot run is not a check that passed. Three of its cases need gitleaks, syft and grype, so folding it into `verify` would make the local gate unrunnable on a laptop that has not installed four scanners. CI runs it per stage (`falsify-ci.mjs CI-01`), where they are all pinned and present.
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:invariants && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run gates && pnpm run falsify

//fast-check: AT THE ROOT FOR scripts/demo's SAKE, and for the same reason `vitest` is here: the demo is deliberately not a workspace package (see its tsconfig), so it has no node_modules of its own and resolves its test-time imports from the root. PT-06 lives in scripts/demo/test because `runDemo` is the only multi-account fold through the real engine in this tree. No package is added that VG-12 has not already admitted: fast-check is in the catalog and is already installed for @merit/rules-engine. NOTE FOR THE NEXT SESSION: this comment sits at the TOP LEVEL and not inside `devDependencies`, where pnpm read a `//`-prefixed key as a real package name and installed it.
